title.value: Memory-Aware Functional IR for Higher-Level Synthesis of Accelerators
title.justification: The title reflects the core content and focus of the paper, which discusses a memory-aware intermediate representation used for synthesizing hardware accelerators.
title.quote: Memory-Aware Functional IR for Higher-Level Synthesis of Accelerators

extractions.description: This paper presents a novel functional intermediate representation (Shir) for synthesizing hardware accelerators on FPGAs. The IR explicitly manages memory operations and parallelism, allowing efficient synthesis of hardware from high-level programming abstractions. The approach is demonstrated with stencil computations and matrix-matrix multiplication on an FPGA, showing competitive performance with optimized OpenCL implementations.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily discusses the synthesis of hardware accelerators using a new intermediate representation and does not directly relate to any specific eco-responsible category such as climate change or pollution control.
primary_category.quote: This article adopts functional programming concepts to provide a hardware-agnostic higher-level programming abstraction.

secondary_categories.justification: The development of more efficient accelerators could indirectly contribute to climate change mitigation if applied in various energy-intensive computations and systems.
secondary_categories.quote: Specialized accelerators deliver orders of a magnitude of higher performance than general-purpose processors.

primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-categories defined do not directly apply to the paper's primary focus on hardware synthesis and accelerators.
primary_sub_category.quote: Adopts functional programming concepts to provide a hardware-agnostic higher-level programming abstraction.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Efficient hardware accelerators can be used in various industrial applications to improve performance and efficiency, potentially leading to reduced energy consumption.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Our compiler produces correct and efficient hardware that is competitive with OpenCL implementations.
